_doc: One entry per logical series the Mexico macro page uses. The fetcher tries each

inegi (Indicadores API, INEGI_TOKEN): the data endpoint has no series name, so an INEGI candidate carries a `search` query; the fetcher runs INEGI's BIE full-text search with it, finds the row whose INDICADOR equals the candidate id and checks the title regex against that row's full topic path (the CL_INDICATOR catalog description is the fallback). IGAE ids 737219/737217/737226/737233/737268 and consumer-confidence ids 454186/454168 were confirmed this way on 2026-09-13.
candidate in order and keeps the first one that (a) answers, (b) carries the
expected title (regex, case-insensitive, checked against the provider's own
metadata) and (c) returns enough points. A candidate whose title does not match
is dropped and reported, so a mistyped ID can never put a wrongly-labelled
series on the page. Providers: banxico (SIE API, token), fred (St. Louis Fed,
key optional; without a key the CSV export is used and the title is not checked
metadata in its response, so only use it for IDs already confirmed in the
INEGI catalog and set title to null).

A candidate may override `freq` (e.g. a monthly FRED fallback for a daily Banxico series) and carry a bilingual `note` {es,en} shown next to the source line. A candidate whose last observation is older than the freshness limit for its frequency (monthly 15 months, quarterly 12 months, daily/weekly 120 days) is treated as discontinued and skipped.

Banxico IDs confirmed against the titles the API reported on 2026-09-13: SP1 (INPC general), SP74625-SP74631 (subyacente, mercancías, mercancías no alimenticias, servicios, otros servicios, no subyacente, energéticos y tarifas), SF43718, SF61745, SF43783, SF43936, SE27803, SF43707. SP74639 (tarifas autorizadas) confirmed on the second run. SP2-SP8 are NOT the INPC spending-purpose groups (they are producer-price and construction-cost indices); the spending groups still need their SIE IDs looked up in the catalog. Not yet sourced: IGAE (SR16734 is the old 2013-base series, discontinued 2023), IMSS jobs, industrial production, consumer confidence (FRED's OECD mirror ended 2023-12); these need INEGI indicator IDs confirmed in the INEGI catalog.

SR14195 confirmed by probe on 2026-09-13: Encuesta de expectativas, inflación general para los próximos 12 meses, mediana (SR14194 is the mean). NOT used since 2026-10-05: it is the 'mes t' variant (the 12 months counted from the survey month itself).

Expected 12-month inflation since 2026-10-05: two statistics of the same Banxico survey, both for the 12 months that FOLLOW the survey month ('Para los próximos 12 meses (mes t+1)' in SIE table CR155): inflExp12mMean = SR16773 (mean) and inflExp12m = SR16774 (median). The mean drives the ex ante real rate because that is Banxico's own definition (Informe Trimestral abril-junio 2026, note 1 to the chart 'Tasa real ex ante de corto plazo': the target minus 'la media de las expectativas de inflación a 12 meses'; its August 2026 figure, 2.35%, is 6.50 - 4.15); the median, the figure Banxico headlines in Cuadro 2 of the survey PDF and the statistic consensus surveys (Citi, Bloomberg) report, is printed beside it. The fiscal monitor shows the same pair. The 'mes t' variants (SR14194 mean, SR14195 median) count the 12 months from the survey month itself and differ month by month (Feb-2018 to Sep-2026 medians: -0.29 to +0.13 pp; Sep-2026: 4.16 vs 4.08): never mix them. The API carries the 'mes t+1' series only from Feb-2018 (N/E before, although the table lists Jan-1999). Ids, labels and the Jul-Sep 2026 values were read from the public CR155 table on 2026-10-05; the fetcher's title check confirms each id on every run.

banxico candidates carry `page`: the public SIE table (consultarCuadro) that holds the series, used as the source link on the page because the API endpoint the fetcher reads needs a token and shows an error to a reader. Mapped by hand on 2026-09-28 from the SIE directory; a new banxico candidate needs one too.

Yield curve (added 2026-10-03; ids and titles confirmed by probe that day): Cetes primary-auction yields SF43936 (28 days), SF43939 (91), SF43942 (182), SF43945 (364), SF349785 (728, since Oct-2022) and fixed-rate Bonos M SF43883 (3 years), SF43886 (5), SF44071 (10), SF45384 (20), SF60696 (30), all from Banxico table CF107; the 10-year U.S. Treasury is FRED DGS10 (Federal Reserve H.15). Banxico's SIE has no daily secondary-market yields (checked 2026-09-28), so each tenor shows its latest auction, at the issue date Banxico records it under (CF107 is 'a su fecha de colocación'; the auction is two business days earlier).

External sector (added 2026-10-08): ids read from Banxico's SIE table pages in sector 1 (CE125 balanza comercial, CE171 exportaciones manufactureras, CE160 participaciones, CE197 comercio con Estados Unidos, CE187 términos de intercambio y valor unitario, CE174 balanza de pagos MBP6, CE158 agregados como % del PIB, CE131 inversión directa principio direccional, CE170 posición de inversión internacional trimestral, CE89 tenencia de no residentes en valores gubernamentales, CE182 deuda externa bruta) and INEGI's BIE search (734407, PIB a precios corrientes); the U.S. side of the bilateral trade (Census EXPMX/IMPMX) and the BLS import price index from Mexico (MEXTOT) come from FRED. Banxico trade series are in thousands of dollars (unit usd_k); the page scales every unit to millions. fetch.mjs checks the accounting identities between these series after each fetch (exports by sector, imports by type, oil/non-oil balances, current-account components, direct-investment components, IIP assets/liabilities/net and its change) and keeps the previous data for a block that fails.

Title regexes of the external-sector series were tightened on 2026-10-08 to the titles the SIE API reported on the first runner fetch (the API title is the table path plus the row path, e.g. "Balanza comercial de mercancías de México Exportaciones totales Petroleras"; the CE170 titles carry "Activos"/"Pasivos" before the category, which tells the two apart). The three CE197 series (trade with the United States) come back from the API with an empty title: they carry allowEmptyTitle and are checked by the identities balUS = expUS - impUS and shExpUS = 100 * expUS / expTotalO instead.

note.es: Puestos de trabajo registrados ante el IMSS al cierre de mes, según el comunicado estadístico mensual del IMSS. Desde julio de 2025 incluye los puestos de personas trabajadoras de plataformas digitales que superan el umbral de ingreso, como los reporta el IMSS; las comparaciones anuales de julio de 2025 a junio de 2026 incluyen esa incorporación. Junio de 2025 no está disponible.
note.en: Jobs registered with IMSS at month-end, from IMSS’s monthly statistical press release. From July 2025 it includes the jobs of digital-platform workers above the income threshold, as IMSS reports them; 12-month comparisons from July 2025 to June 2026 include that addition. June 2025 is not available.
